job.title: LIMBO: Lifelong Inference-Time Memory and Budget Optimization for LLM Agents
job.selection_reason: Treats replay memory as a controllable inference-time resource and jointly allocates memory strategy and compute budget online without weight updates; reports up to about 83% lower inference cost against strong memory-augmented baselines.
